name: Source Collaborator Notification
description: Notifies the assignee when they have a source that has been assigned to them for configuration
subject: $assignedByUser has assigned you an application to onboard in $__global.productName
body:
Source Configuration Assignment

Dear $__recipient.name,

$assignedByUser has assigned an application for you to onboard in $__global.productName.

#if($dueDate)

Due date: $dueDate

#end

Your organization uses $__global.productName to manage identities and access. Onboarding the $referenceName application will allow your organization to manage that data in $__global.productName, where it will be known as a source.

#if($comments)

Comments from $assignedByUser: $comments

#end

Go to your assigned sources to begin configuring the $referenceName application. When you are finished, submit your configurations to your administrator for approval. You can leave comments in the source configuration to get help from your administrator, or refer to Managing Assigned Sources for assistance.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
